name: Nishino Daisuke
source:
The current head of the family shrine. When he was young, he lost both of his parents during a traffic accident. In the same accident, he became infertile due to his wounds.
He was able to keep the shrine upfloat thanks to help from various family members, thus he is obligated to produce an heir to the shrine.
A real hardworker at heart, he is respected by both his brother and the local community.
Fuuka is the only woman he's ever been with.
